_comment: The traders (DESIGN.md §10), read by TraderTable, in the order the TRADERS screen lists them. Each: id (offers.json, quests, insurers and saves use it), name, role, specialty (what they stock), personality (flavour), greetings (one is picked each visit to the TRADERS screen), currency (RUB or USD: what their prices are in), unique (what sets them apart), unlock (null: open from the start; {"quest": id}: trades once that quest is done), locked_greeting (with an unlock: what they say until then, instead of a greeting), max_loyalty (leave out for the top loyalty level in progression.json) and notice (optional: shown at the top of the BUY and BARTER tabs). Selling prices and restocks get their own fields when selling is built.

traders.name: Bulat
traders.specialty: Eastern and civilian guns, ammo, grenades, hunting rifles and shells
traders.personality: A gruff ex-army quartermaster who runs his depot out of a shipping container at the edge of the yard. He counts every round twice and writes it in a ledger older than you are. Heroes bore him; he respects people who come back alive.
greetings: Back in one piece. Good. Now we talk.
Every round in this crate is counted. So are the ones you owe me.
Wipe your boots. Then tell me what you need.

traders.name: Doc Vera
traders.personality: She was a field surgeon at the city hospital until the city stopped needing one; now she patches people up from what's left of its supply room. Tired and dry-humoured, she has seen every wound twice. Nothing makes her angrier than a wasted bandage.
greetings: Sit. Show me where it hurts, then show me your money.
You again. At least you're walking this time.
Don't bleed on the counter. I just cleaned it.

traders.name: Auntie Zoya
traders.specialty: Tools, household goods, batteries, fuel, basic food, survival gear and cheap barters
traders.personality: Auntie Zoya has kept a market stall through two wars and a collapse, and she isn't stopping for this one. She trades anything for anything, never forgets a face and always knows who has what. Call her auntie and she might knock something off the price.
greetings: Come, come, look. Everything is for sale, even the things that aren't.
Eat something first, you look like a ghost. Then we trade.
I heard you were coming. I hear everything.
traders.unique: Cheap barters · can introduce you to The Broker

traders.name: Stitch
traders.specialty: Armor, helmets, rigs, backpacks, headsets, cloth materials and gear upgrades
traders.personality: A quiet tailor who sews plate carriers from whatever you bring him, in a back room lit by one lamp. He measures twice, cuts once and never rushes a seam. If a strap sits crooked he will unpick the whole rig and start again.
greetings: Arms up. Let me see how it sits.
Leave it on the table. I'll look at the stitching.
Mm. That rig is held together with hope. Sit.

traders.name: Tinker
traders.specialty: Weapon parts, mods, magazines and sights
traders.personality: An obsessive gunsmith in a basement workshop full of half-built rifles, every one of them with a name. He talks to guns more than to people, and the guns seem to listen. Show him something rare and broken and he forgets you're in the room.
greetings: Shh, she's nearly zeroed. Right. What do you want?
Put it on the bench. Barrel first. Gently.
Every gun has a story. Yours is a sad one. Let's fix it.

traders.name: Mole
traders.specialty: Buys anything, at a low price; later sells used gear
traders.personality: A shifty dealer who works from a sewer junction under the yard, behind a curtain of dripping pipes. He asks no questions and takes anything, just never for much. He remembers who shoots Scavs and who leaves them be.
greetings: No names. Show me what you've got.
Down here nobody asks where things come from. Me least of all.
Mind the water. And mind who followed you.
traders.notice: Selling isn't open yet. Once it is, Mole buys anything you bring him, at a low price; later he sells used gear too. Nothing to buy or barter here for now.

traders.name: The Broker
traders.specialty: Western guns, top armor and optics, rare goods
traders.personality: A polished fixer who works from a hotel suite with the curtains drawn, in a pressed suit, with a glass of something he never drinks. He deals only with people who come recommended, and only in dollars. With him everything has a price, the introduction included.
greetings: Please, sit. Auntie Zoya speaks well of you, and she rarely speaks well of anyone.
Dollars, of course. I don't handle paper that burns.
Discretion is the first thing I sell. The rest is on the list.
traders.unique: Dollars only · unlocked by Auntie Zoya's introduction
traders.locked_greeting: I don't believe we've been introduced. Come back when someone I trust has said your name.
